summary: Fortive Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a $1.1 billion debt offering ($600M 4.750% notes due 2031, $500M 5.250% notes due 2036). The proceeds will refinance existing indebtedness and for general corporate purposes. The notes are unsecured, rank equally with other unsecured debt, and are not guaranteed. This is a routine capital markets transaction (debt refinancing), not a special situation. No change of control, acquisition, or divestiture is involved.
